lines.text: The writer says to rejoice in the Lord, and believers glory in Christ Jesus without confidence in the flesh.
The writer was circumcised on the eighth day, of the tribe of Judah, a Hebrew of Hebrews, a Pharisee.
The writer persecuted the church as to zeal and was faultless as to righteousness in the law.
The writer wants to know Christ, the power of His resurrection, and to attain resurrection from the dead.
